name: apphandoff
description: AppHandoff for Claude Code: wakes a chat when someone posts on a ticket it claimed or created (it claims the ticket for the chat first, a write on your board; a person's message makes the chat ask you what to do through a board question) or decides a milestone approval or answers a question it asked, or when a person accepts or drops a milestone it worked on, and, only if you turn it on with /inbox standby, lets one chat answer for the board by claiming messages nobody answered, and lists the milestones it touched in one Milestones pane, with every approval waiting on you from any chat.
